title: unified-rollouts: canary + shadow auto-rollback enhancements and observability
author: Aisha Kapoor
body: Motivation: Improve safety and visibility for canary/A-B/shadow rollouts by tightening auto-rollback guards, adding multi-metric quorum support, and improving telemetry so incidents can be diagnosed faster. This change set implements: 1) New rollout config fields to support metric quorums and weighted probing for shadow traffic; 2) Enhanced auto-rollback engine that evaluates multiple metrics with configurable quorum and hysteresis; 3) Probing stage improvements to limit blast radius and support manual quarantine; 4) Telemetry: new rollout-level metrics (rollout_step, probe_failure_count, quorum_threshold_hit, rollback_reason) and distributed tracing hooks for rollout decisions; 5) End-to-end tests and integration test harness for staged shadow + canary scenarios; 6) Docs and API updates for the rollout manifest and console dashboards. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked in Linear ENG-2345 - [x] Add new config schema + validation - [x] Implement multi-metric quorum evaluator - [x] Add telemetry metrics and tracing spans - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] E2E stability test added to perf-canary harness - [x] Docs + changelog. Backwards compatibility: rollout manifest additions are additive and default to existing behavior; no breaking changes expected. Rollout to production: quick canary for internal orgs followed by broader rollout after observability confirms stability. See commits and CI history below for details and the review thread for discussion of thresholds and defaults.
commits: a1b2c3d: feat(rollouts): add multi-metric quorum evaluator and config schema
d4e5f6a: feat(rollouts): integrate quorum into auto-rollback engine; add hysteresis and mute windows
f7a8b9c: perf(rollouts): limit probing concurrency and add adaptive ramp logic for shadow traffic
b1c2d3e: test(rollouts): add e2e tests for staged-shadow + canary scenarios
c3d4e5f: docs(rollouts): rollout manifest examples and console telemetry guide
review_comments: Ethan Morales: Nice work on the quorum evaluator — can we expose per-metric weights in the manifest? Requested change: add a weights field and default to equal weighting.
Aisha Kapoor: Added metric_weights with defaults; updated validation and tests. See commit d4e5f6a for implementation.
Priya Nair: For hysteresis, please ensure the rollback cooldown doesn't block subsequent canary retries. Suggest adding a mute_window config separate from cooldown.
Aisha Kapoor: Added mute_window and clarified semantics in manifest docs; added unit tests to verify behavior.
Jonah Li: Integration tests flaked on the first run due to timing in the prober. Recommend reducing concurrency for probing by default and making conservative ramp steps.
Aisha Kapoor: Reduced default prober concurrency and added adaptive ramp based on probe success rate. Re-ran e2e; passing consistently now.
Ethan Morales: Approving after minor doc clarifications.
Priya Nair: Approved — recommend staging rollout for 48h and then full rollout.
CI Bot: integration-tests failed on first run (timeout). Rerun triggered by @Aisha Kapoor. Subsequent run passed.
release_notes: Enhanced rollout safety and observability: added multi-metric quorum for auto-rollback, probing ramp controls, mute_window config, rollout-level telemetry and tracing, and E2E tests. No breaking changes to existing rollout manifests. Recommended staging: internal orgs -> 48h -> full rollout.
